title: The change cycle builds independent groups in parallel
what: A change whose tasks split into independent groups (no shared files) builds them with parallel workers, then one gate; for every project, not only spec projects (the OpenSpec waves were dropped in favour of one cycle).
why: Proposed by the OpenSpec design (24 Oct): dropping the OpenSpec waves costs about twice the wall time on a 6-group change; the owner's standing order is speed. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: After spec-writing-leaves-the-main-pipeline-sdd-become, a 6-group change builds its groups one after another.
pass_cases: Groups with no shared file build in parallel; groups that share a file go in order; one gate after all.
